template.name: Test Case Outline Document
template.description: Test case outline with unit test nodes and integration test edges for Xbowl user stories

testDataRequirements: Mock user authentication data and session tokens
Mock workflow data and user profile information
Mock dashboard configuration and navigation data
Mock error scenarios and validation responses
Mock responsive design data and breakpoints
Mock permission and access control data

metadata.name: Dashboard Layout Authentication Test
metadata.description: Test DashboardLayout component authentication and session management
metadata.expectedBehavior: Validate user authentication and session, redirect to login if unauthorized
testScenarios: Authenticated user with valid session - should render dashboard layout
Unauthenticated user - should redirect to login page
Expired session - should redirect to login with session expired message
Invalid session - should redirect to login with error message

testData.expectedOutput: Dashboard layout rendered or redirect response
testData.mockData: Mock authentication service, mock session data

metadata.name: Dashboard Layout Error Handling Test
metadata.description: Test DashboardLayout component error handling for session and access issues
metadata.expectedBehavior: Handle session expiration and access denied errors appropriately
testScenarios: Session expired - should show session expired message and redirect
Access denied - should show access denied message
Network error - should show technical error message
Database error - should show error message with retry option

testData.mockData: Mock error responses, mock session errors

metadata.name: Dashboard Page Rendering Test
metadata.description: Test DashboardPage component rendering with user workflows and navigation
metadata.expectedBehavior: Render dashboard page with user workflows, workspace data, and user profile
testScenarios: Valid user data - should render complete dashboard with workflows
Empty workflows - should render dashboard with empty state
User profile data - should display user profile information
Workspace data - should show workspace information and navigation

testData.input: User workflows, workspace data, user profile
testData.expectedOutput: Rendered dashboard page with all components
testData.mockData: Mock workflow data, mock workspace data, mock user profile

metadata.name: Workflow List Rendering Test
metadata.description: Test WorkflowList component rendering with user's saved workflows
metadata.expectedBehavior: Display user's saved workflows with search and filtering capabilities
testScenarios: Workflows available - should render workflow cards in grid layout
Empty workflows - should show empty state with create workflow message
Search functionality - should filter workflows based on search input
Sorting options - should sort workflows by different criteria

testData.input: Workflow list data, search filters, sorting options
testData.expectedOutput: Rendered workflow list with cards and controls
testData.mockData: Mock workflow data, mock filter state, mock sorting options

metadata.name: Workflow List Interactions Test
metadata.description: Test WorkflowList component interactions including selection and filtering
metadata.expectedBehavior: Handle workflow selection, search filtering, and sorting operations
testScenarios: Workflow selection - should highlight selected workflow and enable actions
Search filtering - should filter workflows in real-time as user types
Sorting - should reorder workflows based on selected sort criteria
Workflow actions - should show context menu for workflow operations

testData.input: User interactions, filter inputs, sort selections
testData.expectedOutput: Updated workflow list state, filtered results, sorted order
testData.mockData: Mock user events, mock filter inputs, mock sort selections

metadata.name: Create Workflow Button Rendering Test
metadata.description: Test CreateWorkflowButton component rendering and state
metadata.expectedBehavior: Render button for creating new workflows with proper styling and state
testScenarios: Button rendering - should render button with proper styling and text
Loading state - should show loading spinner when creating workflow
Disabled state - should disable button when user lacks permissions
Responsive design - should adapt button size for different screen sizes

testData.input: Button state, user permissions, responsive breakpoints
testData.expectedOutput: Rendered button with appropriate state and styling
testData.mockData: Mock button state, mock permissions, mock responsive data

metadata.name: Create Workflow Button Interactions Test
metadata.description: Test CreateWorkflowButton component click handling and navigation
metadata.expectedBehavior: Handle button click and navigate to workflow designer
testScenarios: Button click - should handle click event and trigger navigation
Navigation - should navigate to workflow designer page
Permission check - should validate user permissions before navigation
Error handling - should show error message if navigation fails

testData.input: Button click events, navigation requests, permission checks
testData.expectedOutput: Navigation to workflow designer or error message
testData.mockData: Mock click events, mock navigation service, mock permission service

metadata.name: User Profile Rendering Test
metadata.description: Test UserProfile component rendering with user information and settings
metadata.expectedBehavior: Display user profile information and settings with responsive design
testScenarios: Profile data available - should display user information and avatar
Settings panel - should show collapsible settings panel
Profile editing - should show edit mode with form fields
Responsive design - should adapt layout for different screen sizes

testData.input: User profile data, settings configuration, responsive breakpoints
testData.expectedOutput: Rendered user profile with information and settings
testData.mockData: Mock user profile data, mock settings data, mock responsive data

metadata.name: User Profile Interactions Test
metadata.description: Test UserProfile component interactions including editing and logout
metadata.expectedBehavior: Handle profile editing, settings configuration, and logout functionality
testScenarios: Profile editing - should enable edit mode and handle form submission
Settings configuration - should save settings and update UI
Logout functionality - should handle logout and clear session
Settings panel toggle - should expand/collapse settings panel

testData.input: User interactions, form data, settings changes
testData.expectedOutput: Updated profile state, settings changes, logout events
testData.mockData: Mock user events, mock form data, mock settings data

metadata.name: Authentication Service Test
metadata.description: Test authentication service for user registration and sign in
metadata.expectedBehavior: Handle user registration, sign in, session management, and validation
testScenarios: User registration - should validate and create new user account
User sign in - should authenticate credentials and create session
Session validation - should validate existing sessions
Password validation - should enforce password strength requirements

testData.input: Registration data, sign in credentials, session tokens
testData.expectedOutput: Authentication results, session data, validation responses
testData.mockData: Mock user data, mock credentials, mock session tokens

metadata.name: Session Management Service Test
metadata.description: Test session management service for session creation and validation
metadata.expectedBehavior: Handle session creation, validation, expiration, and cleanup
testScenarios: Session creation - should create secure session with proper expiration
Session validation - should validate session tokens and permissions
Session expiration - should handle expired sessions and cleanup
Session refresh - should refresh active sessions and extend expiration

testData.input: Session tokens, user data, expiration times
testData.expectedOutput: Session validation results, expiration status, refresh tokens
testData.mockData: Mock session tokens, mock user data, mock expiration data

metadata.name: Dashboard to Workflow List Integration Test
metadata.description: Test integration between dashboard page and workflow list
metadata.componentInteraction: DashboardPage renders WorkflowList with user workflow data
metadata.dataFlow: User workflow data flows from dashboard to workflow list, selection events flow back
metadata.expectedIntegrationBehavior: Workflow list should display user workflows and handle selection events

testData.expectedOutput: Rendered workflow list with functional selection
testData.mockServices: Mock workflow service, mock user data service

metadata.name: Workflow List to Create Button Integration Test
metadata.description: Test integration between workflow list and create workflow button
metadata.componentInteraction: WorkflowList selection triggers CreateWorkflowButton state changes
metadata.dataFlow: Workflow selection state flows to create button, navigation events flow from button
metadata.expectedIntegrationBehavior: Create button should respond to workflow list state and handle navigation

testData.expectedOutput: Coordinated workflow list and create button behavior
testData.mockServices: Mock workflow selection service, mock navigation service

metadata.name: Authentication to Dashboard Integration Test
metadata.description: Test integration between authentication service and dashboard layout
metadata.componentInteraction: AuthenticationService validates user, DashboardLayout renders based on auth status
metadata.dataFlow: Authentication results flow to dashboard layout, session data flows to layout
metadata.expectedIntegrationBehavior: Dashboard layout should render based on authentication status and session data

testData.expectedOutput: Dashboard layout with proper authentication state
testData.mockServices: Mock authentication service, mock session service

metadata.name: Session to Dashboard Integration Test
metadata.description: Test integration between session management and dashboard page
metadata.componentInteraction: SessionManagementService validates session, DashboardPage renders user data
metadata.dataFlow: Session validation results flow to dashboard page, user data flows to page
metadata.expectedIntegrationBehavior: Dashboard page should render user data based on session validation

testData.expectedOutput: Dashboard page with user workflows and profile data
testData.mockServices: Mock session service, mock user data service
